senses.definition: Carefully attentive to details; studious; diligent in performing a process or procedure.
senses.example: All these painstaking men, considered together, may be said to have completed another species of criticism.

senses.definition: The application of careful and attentive effort.
senses.example: I esteeme Bocace his Decameron, Rabelais, and the kisses of John the second (if they may be placed under this title) worth the paines-taking to reade them.
